description: Adversarial multi-venue economic synchrony benchmark corpus (#64)

cases.label: out-of-order-observations
cases.description: Three venues report agreeing NAV/price values in conflicting arrival order

cases.label: conflicting-authoritative-attestations
cases.description: Two authoritative fund administrator venues attest different NAV values for the same subject/proposition

cases.label: duplicate-delivery
cases.description: The identical venue delivery is delivered twice (retry/replay); must be idempotent

cases.label: late-authoritative-evidence
cases.description: Authoritative evidence arrives with skew beyond lateEvidenceThresholdMs

cases.label: stale-evidence
cases.description: Venue delivery references evidence older than the policy maxEvidenceAgeMs

cases.label: expired-revoked-attestation
cases.description: A venue attestation envelope is REVOKED and must not be admitted

cases.label: valid-but-wrong-scope-attestation
cases.description: A trusted ORACLE venue attempts to attest NAV (out of scope for ORACLE)

cases.label: representation-share-class-mismatch
cases.description: Representation identities whose share classes differ must not be equivalent

cases.label: bridge-wrapper-ambiguity
cases.description: A wrapped representation lacks explicit bridge lineage, so equivalence is unsupported

cases.label: chain-reorg-superseded-block
cases.description: Venue chain observation is PENDING/REORGED and the policy requires finalized observations

cases.label: provider-disagreement
cases.description: Two independent oracles attest conflicting observed prices

cases.label: no-op-vs-material-change
cases.description: Re-delivering the already-applied authoritative NAV is a no-op that must not create a version

cases.label: event-retry-replay
cases.description: An identical authoritative NAV event is re-delivered; replay must be deterministic and conflict-free

cases.label: false-equivalence-ai-proposal
cases.description: AI proposes ECONOMICALLY_EQUIVALENT_TO on basis that cannot establish equivalence; must be rejected
